items.text: On Saturday morning. <break time="0.8s" /> I reminded my uncle. <break time="0.8s" /> That I wished to go to the bazaar in the evening. <break time="0.8s" /> And he answered curtly. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, boy, I know. <break time="0.8s" /> At seven oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> The servant came to tell me. <break time="0.8s" /> That my uncle had not yet come home. <break time="0.8s" /> And I sat staring at the clock. <break time="0.8s" /> For some time. <break time="0.8s" /> When its ticking began. <break time="0.8s" /> To irritate me. <break time="0.8s" /> I left the room. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked up and down. <break time="0.8s" /> The cold, empty, gloomy rooms upstairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Singing to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> At nine oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> I heard my uncles latchkey. <break time="0.8s" /> In the hall door. <break time="0.8s" /> And I could tell. <break time="0.8s" /> From the way he talked to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had been drinking. <break time="0.8s" /> When I asked him a second time. <break time="0.8s" /> For the money to go to the bazaar. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had forgotten all about it. <break time="0.8s" /> Finally he gave me a florin. <break time="0.8s" /> And I held it tightly in my hand. <break time="0.8s" /> As I walked quickly. <break time="0.8s" /> Down to the station. <break time="0.8s" /> I took my seat. <break time="0.8s" /> In a third class carriage. <break time="0.8s" /> Of a deserted train. <break time="0.8s" /> Which, after an intolerable delay. <break time="0.8s" /> Crept slowly out of the station. <break time="0.8s" /> It was ten minutes to ten. <break time="0.8s" /> When I finally reached the bazaar. <break time="0.8s" /> And I saw the large building. <break time="0.8s" /> With its magical name. <break time="0.8s" /> Shining above the door.

토요일 아침에. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 삼촌에게 상기시켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 저녁에 바자회에 가고 싶다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 퉁명스럽게 대답했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래, 얘야, 안다. <break time="0.8s" /> 일곱 시에. <break time="0.8s" /> 하녀가 내게 말하러 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 삼촌이 아직 집에 오지 않았다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 시계를 노려보며 앉아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 째깍 소리가 시작하자. <break time="0.8s" /> 나를 짜증 나게 하기. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 방을 나왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 이리저리 걸었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 위층의 춥고 텅 빈 음울한 방들을. <break time="0.8s" /> 혼자 노래하며. <break time="0.8s" /> 아홉 시에. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 삼촌의 열쇠 소리를 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 현관문에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 알 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 혼잣말하는 방식으로 보아. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 술을 마셔 왔다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 두 번째로 그에게 요청하자. <break time="0.8s" /> 바자회에 갈 돈을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것을 완전히 잊어버렸다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 마침내 그는 내게 플로린 한 닢을 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 그것을 손에 꼭 쥐었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 빠르게 걸어가며. <break time="0.8s" /> 역으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 자리에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 3등 객차에. <break time="0.8s" /> 텅 빈 열차의. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 열차는 참을 수 없는 지체 끝에. <break time="0.8s" /> 천천히 역을 기어 나갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 10시 10분 전이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 마침내 바자회에 도착했을 때는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 커다란 건물을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 마법 같은 이름이. <break time="0.8s" /> 문 위에서 빛나고 있는.

Taking two torches. <break time="0.8s" /> I led Fortunato down. <break time="0.8s" /> A long and winding staircase. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the deep vaults. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the Montresor family. <break time="0.8s" /> The nitre. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at the white webs. <break time="0.8s" /> That shone on the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he began to cough. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us go back. <break time="0.8s" /> Because your health is precious. <break time="0.8s" /> And you are rich, respected, and loved, just as I once was I said. <break time="0.8s" /> The cough is nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And it will not kill me. <break time="0.8s" /> He answered. <break time="0.8s" /> I shall not die of a cough. <break time="0.8s" /> True, true. <break time="0.8s" /> I replied. <break time="0.8s" /> And I gave him a bottle of fine wine. <break time="0.8s" /> From a long row. <break time="0.8s" /> Lying on the damp ground. <break time="0.8s" /> He lifted the bottle to his lips. <break time="0.8s" /> And said with a smile. <break time="0.8s" /> I drink to the dead. <break time="0.8s" /> Who lie around us. <break time="0.8s" /> And I drink to your long life. <break time="0.8s" /> I answered. <break time="0.8s" /> And we walked on deeper into the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> Our family arms show. <break time="0.8s" /> A golden foot crushing a snake. <break time="0.8s" /> And our motto means. <break time="0.8s" /> No one attacks me. <break time="0.8s" /> Without being punished. <break time="0.8s" /> Later when he asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether I was one of the masons. <break time="0.8s" /> A secret brotherhood. <break time="0.8s" /> I told him that I was. <break time="0.8s" /> Here is my sign. <break time="0.8s" /> I said. <break time="0.8s" /> And I pulled a small trowel. <break time="0.8s" /> From under my cloak. <break time="0.8s" /> But he only laughed at my joke.

횃불 두 개를 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 포르투나토를 데리고 내려갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 길고 구불구불한 계단을 따라. <break time="0.8s" /> 깊은 지하 저장고로. <break time="0.8s" /> 몬트레소르 가문의. <break time="0.8s" /> 초석이군. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하얀 거미줄 같은 것을 보며. <break time="0.8s" /> 벽에서 반짝이는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고는 기침을 하기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 돌아가세. <break time="0.8s" /> 자네 건강은 소중하니까. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 자네는 한때의 나처럼 부유하고 존경받고 사랑받으니까 내가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기침은 아무것도 아니야. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것이 나를 죽이지는 않아. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 대답했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기침 때문에 죽지는 않을 걸세. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇지, 그렇고말고. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 대답했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그에게 좋은 포도주 한 병을 건넸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 길게 늘어선 줄에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 축축한 바닥에 놓인. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 병을 입술로 들어 올렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 웃으며 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 죽은 이들을 위해 건배하지. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 주위에 누워 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그럼 나는 자네의 장수를 위해 건배하지. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 대답했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 우리는 계속 걸었다 땅속 더 깊이. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 가문의 문장은 보여 준다. <break time="0.8s" /> 황금빛 발이 뱀을 짓밟는 모습을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 우리 가문의 좌우명은 뜻한다. <break time="0.8s" /> 누구도 나를 공격할 수 없다. <break time="0.8s" /> 벌을 받지 않고서는. <break time="0.8s" /> 나중에 그가 물었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 메이슨의 일원인지. <break time="0.8s" /> 비밀 형제단인. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그렇다고 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이게 내 표식일세. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 작은 흙손을 꺼냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 망토 밑에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 내 농담에 웃기만 했다.

Leaning with both arms. <break time="0.8s" /> Over the low roof of the boats cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> The white man said to the steersman. <break time="0.8s" /> We will spend the night. <break time="0.8s" /> In Arsats clearing. <break time="0.8s" /> For it is late. <break time="0.8s" /> The steersman only grunted in reply. <break time="0.8s" /> And the boat moved on up a broad river. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose surface shone like metal. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the afternoon sun. <break time="0.8s" /> While the forests on both banks. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood motionless. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the steersman swung the boat. <break time="0.8s" /> At a right angle. <break time="0.8s" /> And drove it through a gap in the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a narrow creek. <break time="0.8s" /> Dark and deep like a ditch. <break time="0.8s" /> Immense trees rose on both sides. <break time="0.8s" /> Their roots twisting. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the black water. <break time="0.8s" /> And the voices of the paddlers. <break time="0.8s" /> Echoed strangely. <break time="0.8s" /> In the gloom beneath the leaves. <break time="0.8s" /> At last the creek opened. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a wide lagoon. <break time="0.8s" /> So still and dark. <break time="0.8s" /> That the forest and the evening sky. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay reflected on its surface. <break time="0.8s" /> As in a mirror. <break time="0.8s" /> Far across the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood a small house. <break time="0.8s" /> Built on high posts. <break time="0.8s" /> Over whose roof. <break time="0.8s" /> Two slender palm trees leaned. <break time="0.8s" /> And the steersman pointed out. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsats canoe tied beneath it. <break time="0.8s" /> The boatmen would have preferred. <break time="0.8s" /> To sleep anywhere else. <break time="0.8s" /> For they did not like Arsat. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was a stranger to their country. <break time="0.8s" /> And lived where no one else dared to live. <break time="0.8s" /> It was said. <break time="0.8s" /> That a man who repairs a ruined house and dwells in it. <break time="0.8s" /> Shows that he is not afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> To live among the spirits that haunt abandoned places.

두 팔을 기댄 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 배 선실의 낮은 지붕 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 백인 여행자는 키잡이에게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오늘 밤은 묵겠네. <break time="0.8s" /> 아르사트의 빈터에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 늦었으니까. <break time="0.8s" /> 키잡이는 대꾸로 끙 소리만 냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 배는 넓은 강을 거슬러 나아갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 강의 수면은 금속처럼 빛났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오후의 햇살 아래에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그동안 양쪽 기슭의 숲은. <break time="0.8s" /> 미동도 없이 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 갑자기 키잡이가 배를 홱 돌렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 직각으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것을 기슭의 틈으로 몰았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 좁은 샛강 안으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 도랑처럼 어둡고 깊은. <break time="0.8s" /> 거대한 나무들이 양쪽에 솟아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 뿌리들은 뒤틀려 나와 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 검은 물 밖으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 노 젓는 사람들의 목소리는. <break time="0.8s" /> 이상하게 메아리쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나뭇잎 아래 어둠 속에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 마침내 샛강이 열렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 넓은 석호로. <break time="0.8s" /> 너무나 고요하고 어두워서. <break time="0.8s" /> 숲과 저녁 하늘이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 수면에 비쳐 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마치 거울 속처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 물 건너 멀리에. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 집 한 채가 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 높은 기둥 위에 지어진. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 지붕 위로. <break time="0.8s" /> 가느다란 야자나무 두 그루가 기울어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 키잡이는 가리켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 아래 묶인 아르사트의 카누를. <break time="0.8s" /> 뱃사공들은 더 좋아했을 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다른 어디에서든 자는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 아르사트를 좋아하지 않았기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 그들의 땅에서 이방인이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아무도 감히 살지 않는 곳에 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들은 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 무너진 집을 고쳐 그 안에 사는 사람은. <break time="0.8s" /> 두려워하지 않는다는 것을 보여 준다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 버려진 곳에 출몰하는 영혼들 사이에서 사는 것을.

One day. <break time="0.8s" /> They met Baviaan. <break time="0.8s" /> The wise old baboon. <break time="0.8s" /> He was the wisest animal. <break time="0.8s" /> In all of South Africa. <break time="0.8s" /> Where did all the animals go. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked the Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> Baviaan winked and said. <break time="0.8s" /> They went into other spots. <break time="0.8s" /> My advice to you, Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> Is to go into other spots. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as you can. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the hunter asked. <break time="0.8s" /> And what about me. <break time="0.8s" /> You should change, too, as soon as you can said Baviaan. <break time="0.8s" /> They did not understand. <break time="0.8s" /> But they went to look for the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> After many days. <break time="0.8s" /> They saw a great, tall forest. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the tree trunks were covered. <break time="0.8s" /> With spots and stripes of shadow. <break time="0.8s" /> It is dark here. <break time="0.8s" /> But full of little pieces of light. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Leopard.
